title: LIMITED-TIME LOGIN EVENT OPEN
lines: DETAILS: During the event, players can sign in for 10 days to earn the following rewards.
Day 1: Ice Cream Bunny Sofa* 1, LMD * 30000
Day 2: 'Blocky Bro'* 1, Top Emergency Sanity Potion * 2
Day 4: Originite Prime * 1, Strategic Battle Record * 10
Day 5: Top Emergency Sanity Potion * 2, Skill Summary - 2 * 15
Day 8: Velvet Snow Rug* 1, Top Emergency Sanity Potion * 2
Day 9: EPOQUE-Eggcellent Craftsman for Greyy* 1, Strategic Battle Record * 15
- The Top Emergency Sanity Potion from this event will expire on December 13, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7).
- Players can earn all the rewards even without signing in consecutively.
